title_original: 제주4ㆍ3사건 진상규명 및 희생자명예회복에 관한 특별법에 의한 가족관계 등록사무처리규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (General Matters)
(1) Matters not prescribed in these Rules shall be governed by the procedures prescribed in the Act on the Registration, etc. of Family Relationships and the Rules on the Registration, etc. of Family Relationships. <Amended on May 27, 2021>
(2) Other matters necessary for application and reporting procedures and processing by the heads of Sis, Eups, and Myeons shall be prescribed by the Supreme Court Regulations. <Newly Inserted on May 27, 2021>
